description: Send a message on behalf of an agent's user or an SMB across WhatsApp (free during launch), SMS, email, or voice, sent immediately, no scheduling. Every send passes a non-bypassable gate: TCPA, GDPR, CASL where modeled, else the service's own opt-in default (the Gulf included). Marketing on SMS, voice, WhatsApp and non-US email without recorded opt-in is rejected (compliance_violation receipt). US marketing email follows CAN-SPAM opt-out rules. [from $0.02/call, variable, not charged while no payment rail is on] [async→get_outcome] [Not available on this deployment: SMS, Voice.]
